name: Disaster -- response measures + event reality, one session (128 cards; round 3 = reserve)
instructions: One card = one event; read the EVENT once, then answer one question per document shown. Documents are labelled by source. Judge only what is asked; 'Unclear' is fine, don't guess. The card label tells you the ROUND: finish round 1 first, then export and run the loader (it says which blocks to stop or continue). Links: tappable once the app patch validation/app_patch_links_2026-10-04.diff is applied (DIS1004-D18); before that they show as plain text (copy them).

REGIONAL ACT: does this pravo.gov.ru act RESPOND to THIS event (ЧС / повышенная готовность regime for it, a mourning day for it, reserve-fund or budget money for its consequences, payments to its victims)? NO if it concerns a different incident (even same region, same type, same weeks), a standing procedure or generic budget matter, or covid/war/farming. Then pick the act's type whatever its relation to the event.

EVENT REALITY: judge the event record itself (no document). YES = one discrete harmful incident (accident, disaster, fire, poisoning, collapse, negligence...) that happened in this region around this date. Otherwise pick why not. Judge from the description; search (Google line) only if the region or the incident is unclear.
